question: Which of the following scientists has NOT received the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Dheeraj Kumar.__** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for the time 2019 in the Medical category has been awarded to Dr Dheeraj Kumar of the International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology, New Delhi, for his outstanding work on host-directed intervention strategies to target tuberculosis. 
 
• In **Biological Science Category,** **Dr. Amit Singh won the award in the department of microbiology and cell biology.**
 
• He is from the** Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru. **
 
• In** Earth, Atmosphere, Ocean, Planetary, Category, Dr. Binoy Kumar Saikia from Coal and Energy Research Group,** won this award.
 
• **In Mathematical Category, Dr. Anish Ghosh, from the academy of mathematics, won the award. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Bhatnagar Award is awarded annually for notable and outstanding exploration in the following categories **Biological category, Chemical category, Earth, Atmosphere, Ocean, and Planetary lines. **
 
• It was introduced in** 1958** by the **Council of Scientific and Industrial Research** in honour of **Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar,** its author-director, and recognises excellence in scientific exploration in India. 
 
• Nallathamby Kalaiselvi has been appointed as the **Director-General of the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) and Secretary of the Department of Scientific and Research (DSIR). **
 
• This award has been given to **11 scientists from the country** for their significant contributions to science and technology.
 
• Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar is also known as the **"father of research laboratories"** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Awarded For- ****Multi-disciplinary science award.**
 
• **Sponsored By - Council of Scientific and Industrial exploration**. 
 
• ** First Winner - Kariamanickam Srinivasa Krishnan.** 
 
• **First Awarded - 1958.**
 
• **Categories in which Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Divided:**
 
 
• **​Biological Sciences.**
 
• **Chemical Sciences.**
 
• **Earth, Atmosphere, Ocean, and Planetary Sciences.**
 
• **Engineering Sciences.**
 
• **Mathematical Sciences.**
 
• **Medical Sciences.**
 
• **Physical Sciences.**
 
 
 
• **(Each Category can have multiple winners {Maximum two}).**
